title: Colombia Rejects Joint Plan With U.S. to Target Drug Gangs
summary_full: The Colombian president said his nation would not allow American forces to take part in anti-cartel military operations on its soil, according to U.S. officials. He later denied that his government had rejected a cooperation plan.
